notes.eligible: Replace with the official register size published by the CEC (בעלי זכות בחירה). 7,340,000 is the approximate figure reported before the election.
notes.results_url: Same path as 2019–2022 (media2X.bechirot.gov.il/files/expb.csv). Returned 404 on 9.10.2026; the CEC fills it on election night.

notes.envelopes_expected: Valid votes expected in double envelopes, if the CEC announces it; otherwise estimated from 2022.
